hed: NTSB recovers flight recorders after Miami Amazon cargo overrun; 5 dead on ground
dek: Amazon Air Flight 7598, a Boeing 767 operated by 21 Air, overran a Miami International Airport runway around 1:53 p.m. Sunday after arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico. The jet struck a cleaning-crew van with seven people aboard inside the airport fence and a Toyota outside; all five people killed were in the vehicles, and the flight crew survived. At a Monday briefing, NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said the flight data and cockpit voice recorders had been recovered and sent to NTSB headquarters in Washington, with 32 investigators on a “devastating” scene still in fact-finding. Two of four runways remained closed, fuel removal was ongoing, and the crew had not yet been interviewed.

cl.body: BBC, Guardian, and CBS Miami stress the ground death toll, hub delays with runways still closed, and victim recovery before full wreckage access after Homendy’s Monday briefing.
